full_prompt_en: A square watercolor and ink caricature shows a worried man in a black flat cap filling the left foreground of a crowded café. His large hooked nose, drawn mouth, and raised furrowed brows are exaggerated but carefully shaded, and his eyes glance toward the upper right. He wears a charcoal jacket, muted gray shirt, and dark tie. Behind him, glass shelves hold many bottles in the pale interior. At a small counter on the right, a woman with round glasses and short blue gray hair looks up with surprise, wearing a light blue jacket over a pale blouse. Two older men lean toward her from either side, one partly hidden at the back and the other bald and bespectacled at the far right. On the counter, a shallow glass, a bottle with golden liquid, and other clear vessels catch the bright indoor light. The near man's face takes up almost half the composition, making the smaller background conversation feel crowded and slightly distant. Slender dark ink lines define folds, wrinkles, bottle edges, and furniture frames. Transparent gray, tan, olive, and muted blue watercolor washes bring gentle volume without filling every paper gap. Light enters broadly from the upper right, washing the shelves and glassware pale while shadow gathers along the cap and the foreground jaw. The cartoon feels observant, wry, and uneasy, with domestic detail surrounding one large troubled expression.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形水彩墨线讽刺漫画描绘一名戴黑色鸭舌帽、神情忧虑的男子，占满拥挤咖啡馆的左前景。大鹰钩鼻、下撇的嘴和扬起皱眉受到夸张但仔细的阴影塑造，眼睛瞥向右上。他穿炭灰外套、低饱和灰衬衫和深色领带。身后，玻璃架上摆着许多瓶子，室内颜色浅淡。右侧小柜台旁，一名短蓝灰发、戴圆眼镜的女子惊讶抬头，浅蓝外套里是浅色上衣。两位年长男子从两侧靠向她，一位部分藏在后面，另一位秃头、戴眼镜，位于最右边。柜台上，浅酒杯、一只盛金色液体的瓶子和其他透明器皿接住明亮室内光。近处男子的脸占近半构图，使后方较小的交谈显得拥挤而稍远。纤细深墨线界定褶皱、皱纹、瓶缘和家具框架。透明灰、浅褐、橄榄与低饱和蓝水彩洗色添出柔和体积，却不填满每处纸白。光从右上宽广进入，把架子和玻璃器皿洗成浅色，帽下与前景下颌聚起阴影。漫画观察细致、带揶揄和不安，日常细节围着一张巨大的愁容。
style_prompt_en: Watercolor and ink caricature pairs precise expressive contour with pale transparent wash and dense everyday detail. An oversized near form dominates one side, while several smaller interlocking shapes recede into a lightly structured background. Fine hatching models deep folds and narrow recesses; light gray, tan, muted blue, olive, and charcoal washes leave the paper visible. Glassy highlights and straight narrow lines punctuate softer rounded masses. The perspective feels close and slightly compressed, increasing the sense of social tension without chaotic layout. Broad indoor light brightens the rear and upper planes, while the near dark mass retains stronger shadow. Proportional exaggeration emphasizes expression, yet the materials remain carefully observed. The image feels wry, uneasy, and richly drawn, with a pale airy palette offsetting the heavy focal silhouette.
style_prompt_zh: 水彩墨线讽刺漫画把准确有表情的轮廓与浅透明洗色、密集日常细节结合。一块放大的近处形体主导一侧，几块更小互锁形状退入轻轻构造的背景。细排线塑造深褶和窄凹处；浅灰、浅褐、低饱和蓝、橄榄与炭灰洗色露出纸面。玻璃般高光与细直线刺入较柔圆润体块。透视贴近且略压缩，增强社交紧张感，却不让布局混乱。宽广室内光照亮后方和上层平面，近处深色体量留有更强阴影。比例夸张强调表情，材料仍观察细致。图像揶揄、不安且画工丰厚，浅色通透色域平衡沉重焦点剪影。
theme_en: Worried man in a cap at a crowded café counter
theme_zh: 拥挤咖啡馆柜台前戴帽男子神情忧虑
name: Joep Bertrams
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
